# API Design

This folder contains the output from the `/api-design` skill.

## Contents (generated by agent)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `graphql-schema.md` | Full GraphQL SDL: scalars, enums, types, queries, mutations, subscriptions |
| `grpc-proto-files.md` | gRPC `.proto` definitions for all Go microservices |
| `ocpi-endpoint-catalog.md` | OCPI 2.1.1 and 2.2.1 endpoint inventory with spec citations |
| `deployment-architecture.md` | AWS deployment Mermaid diagram + draw.io + infrastructure spec table |
| `deployment-architecture.drawio` | draw.io AWS architecture diagram |

## Run `/api-design` to generate these files (requires `/approve data-models` first).
